probe: Siril 1.4.4 stretch/pm semantics on a synthetic ramp card (4096-step linspace 0..1, 32f) — settles whether the sanctioned toolset can express the documented placed-points asinh transfer headlessly

verdicts.asinh_command_model: CONFIRMED by curve fit: y = asinh(stretch*(x-offset)/(1-offset)) / asinh(stretch); offset is a placed BLACK point (input renormalized after subtraction), white is FIXED at 1.0, output CLIPS below-black to 0 (measured min 0.0 on a ramp whose model value was -0.437)
verdicts.asinh_fit_residuals: model matches measured to <=1e-4 at x={0.05,0.25,0.5,1.0} for stretch=100 with and without offset=0.05
verdicts.pm_no_clip: pm PRESERVES out-of-range values in 32f: linear map (x-0.05)/(0.25-0.05) produced min -0.25 max +4.75 and they ROUND-TRIP through save/load intact
verdicts.pm_functions: asinh() inside pm is exact (asinh($r$*20)/asinh(20) hits 0.99997 at x=1); max() and the screen expression 1-(1-a)(1-b) both evaluate correctly
verdicts.pm_token_form: $name$ tokens reference images by FILENAME in cwd; pm ignores the loaded image ($T$ is not a token — 'invalid arguments')

consequence: the documented placed-points transfer (black = measured pedestal B, white = measured disc/ring level W, asinh curve) is natively expressible per filter as ONE pm line: asinh(S*($f$-B)/(W-B))/asinh(S), with explicit max(...,0) if below-black clipping is wanted. FITS Liberator v5 adoption is NOT forced by capability (the pre-registered adoption condition 'if Siril asinh cannot express the placed-points transfer' did NOT fire); FL remains the fidelity-reference alternative only
